order_01.dialog: Welcome back to Sunny Cove, Marina! That storm was nasty. Gather me a few shells and we will get started.

order_02.dialog: First, let us tidy up. Bring me a couple more shells from the beach.

order_03.dialog: Hey! I am Kai. For the bar we need limes - tap the drinks crate.

order_04.dialog: We will not get far without tools. Show me you can dig up a screw.

order_05.dialog: A fresh juice helps me think. Mix me one?

order_06.dialog: The old counter can be saved! Bring a screwdriver and I will fit it.

order_07.dialog: Hi, I am Shelly. For my garden - do you have a seed?

order_08.dialog: Guests are coming soon. Some colorful shells for decoration would be lovely.

order_09.dialog: Time for the roof! With a hammer we can raise the frame.

order_10.dialog: Looking better already! A cool coconut drink to celebrate?

order_11.dialog: Please gather a small shell collection - I will hang it up.

order_12.dialog: The sign needs to go back up so people can find us!

order_13.dialog: My first plant is growing! Bring me a small plant to compare.

order_14.dialog: The surfers are asking. Got any surf wax for them?

order_15.dialog: Have a seat - once you have brought over this bar stool.

order_16.dialog: A proper cocktail lifts the whole bar. Give it a try!

order_17.dialog: One more stool and two guests can toast together.

order_18.dialog: Oh! A hibiscus in a pot - exactly what my garden needs.

order_19.dialog: For the evenings we need light. I will trade a simple surfboard for the string lights.

order_20.dialog: Let us hang the string lights! Bring tools and a drink for Kai.

order_21.dialog: Guests love flowers. A bouquet from Shelly's beds?

order_22.dialog: My planter is all planted - take a look and bring me more shells.

order_23.dialog: Fresh flowers on the counter! Then the bar really shines.

order_24.dialog: A pro surfboard as decor - that pulls the surfers in.

order_25.dialog: For the grand opening: a cocktail tray full of drinks.

order_26.dialog: Hang the surfboard as decor - bring the board and tools!

order_27.dialog: Almost there! My decorative palm is waiting for its spot.

order_28.dialog: Time for the last palm - then Marina's Beach Bar is back!

order_29.dialog: Grand opening! A legendary surf set as the eye-catcher.

order_30.dialog: Sunny Cove shines again. Crown the day with a beach bar spread - to Marina!

tut_01.text: Back at last, Marina! The storm really hit Grandma's beach bar. Do not worry - together we will fix it. Let me show you how.

tut_02.text: It all starts on the beach. Tap the washed-up beach crate - it spits out finds.

tut_03.text: Two matching finds make a better one. Slide two shell shards together!

tut_04.text: Each crate tap costs a little energy - up in the bar. Energy refills over time, so pace yourself!

tut_05.text: For the first order we need two small shells. Keep tapping the crate and merge until you have two.

tut_06.text: Perfect! Open the order card and hand over the two shells.

tut_07.text: And the register rings! Collect your reward.

tut_08.text: Every delivery brings the bar back a little. Take a look at the restoration view!

tut_09.text: When the board gets tight, just sell an item for coins. Give it a quick try.

tut_10.text: The covered fields at the bottom are still locked - you will unlock them as you level up. Now: on to rebuilding Sunny Cove!

tut_done.text: You have got the hang of it! From here the orders will guide you.
